notes.title: Rallygator Developer Stream
notes.notes: Get a exclusive look at Rallygator, a thrilling new racing/Adventure/exploring/platformer game! Watch as the game's creator (Me!) takes you through a demo of the Next Fest version, providing commentary and insights into the game's development. You'll also get a see some early prototype footage of Rallygator.

notes.title: Rallygator Next fest stream! + cats.
notes.notes: Join me as I play my latest game on Steam Next Fest Stream! Not only will you get to see me in action, but you'll also get to see my two furry friends in the webcam feed as they join in on the fun. Get ready for some gaming and cute cat moments all in one stream!

notes.title: Developer plays Rallygator, shows prototypes, QA
notes.notes: Get a exclusive look at Rallygator, a thrilling new racing/Adventure/exploring/platformer game! Watch as the game's creator (Me!) takes you through a demo of the Next Fest version, providing commentary and insights into the game's development. You'll also get a sneak peek at an early prototype of Rallygator and have the opportunity to ask questions and provide feedback.
